title: State Department UAP Cable 1, Papua New Guinea, January 28, 1985
doc_notes: This document is a diplomatic cable from the U.S. Embassy in Port Moresby to USCINCPAC regarding reports of unidentified aerial phenomena over Papua New Guinea on January 24, 1985.

incidents.summary: Reports of high-altitude, high-speed aircraft over Papua New Guinea, including visual sightings of contrails and radar contacts.
incidents.quote: various reports of unidentified aerial phenomena the night of January 24, including fast-moving objects with lights, contrails, and noise.
